subject: integration
name: Bitcoin network standard (BTC_NET_0_1)
summary: Defines reads of the Bitcoin chain (coins, transactions, address history, fees, height, spends, activity) and broadcasting an already signed transaction, with a READONLY profile that keeps only the reads. The row runs nothing and names no server. A node that answers learns every address asked about, and a broadcast shows the transaction. The definition asks for no proof of any answer, so a provider could lie about balances or fees and nothing here would show it; each provider is judged on its own row. Level 4 with privacy: a pure definition. Judged here by its publisher.
